title: THE A3 OWNER-GATED ESCALATION — ANSWERED BY THE OPERATOR

the_escalation.question: the elite-class model ceiling: at zero paid cost the system runs Qwen3-1.7B (quality_tier 4) which measurably fails synthesis on fresh problems — every production run ended INCOMPLETE_INFERENCE_FAILURE / RUN_BLOCKED_CAPABILITY
the_escalation.external_audit_section: EXT-AUDIT-LEAN-R454 §N.1: 'the dominant risk to the mission and it is outside code'; §O: 'the next round's intelligence where the measurement says the bottleneck is'

operator_action.directive_verbatim: Use these to use free ai models like qwen 3.8, glm 5.3, deepseek, minimax etc. once tokens run out of one go to the next provider
operator_action.what_was_delivered: four free-tier API router credentials (unorouter, xkiro, apinex, b.ai) — each a distinct economic account
operator_action.keys_handling: delivered via the IM channel; wired as HF Space secrets at deploy time (env-injected, never in the repo, commits, logs, or records — BS-021; masked fingerprints only in the probe artifact)

the_implementation.policy_amendment: model_cost_policy.py v1.1.0 — FREE_TIER_API joins the ZERO_PAID_COST eligible set, the operator directive quoted verbatim as the provenance (Art. XXVII: a policy change is an operator action; PAID_API / ENVIRONMENT_GRANT / UNDECLARED stay refused fail-closed)
the_implementation.registration: 4 ProviderSpecs (llm_registry.py), each LIVE-MEASURED before registration (probe-before-admit): unorouter glm-5.3:free 3.9s; xkiro qwen/qwen3.8-max:free 3.2s + minimax/minimax-m3:free 3.4s; apinex free/deepseek-v4.1-flash 2.4s; bai qwen3.8-flash 1.5s + mimo-v2.5 1.9s (FAST+CHEAP honest tier — its flagships are deposit-gated)
the_implementation.transport: xkiro + apinex carry a browser User-Agent on EVERY call/probe/catalog fetch (measured: Cloudflare 403 error 1010 bans the default urllib UA; a Chrome UA passes) — the new ProviderSpec.extra_headers field, transport-only
the_implementation.rotation_rule: the operator's 'once tokens run out of one go to the next provider' maps to the existing bounded cascade + typed failure classes, EXTENDED with the measured specimens: unorouter 403 'free providers hit their rate limit' -> RATE_LIMITED (cooldown + advance); xkiro 403 'requires real deposited balance' / b.ai 403 'Deposit required' / b.ai 400 'credit insufficient balance' -> CREDIT_EXHAUSTED (advance); classify_failure now reads the HTTPError BODY (merged into the hint text, exc.code pulled into the status) so the provider's own words classify — 401 stays strictly AUTH
the_implementation.accounts: four DISTINCT account domains added to the closed vocabulary (OWNER_{UNOROUTER,XKIRO,APINEX,BAI}_ACCOUNT) — genuine economic redundancy (one account's exhaustion cannot kill the others)

the_measurement.gate_before: strong_route_capability() = DEGRADED_ONLY (localqwen CHEAP-only) — every run RUN_BLOCKED_CAPABILITY
the_measurement.gate_after: strong_route_capability() = OK with 6 STRONG free rungs (unorouter glm-5.3:free + qwen3.8-27b:free, xkiro qwen3.8-max:free + minimax-m3:free, apinex free/deepseek-v4.1-flash + free/glm-5.3-flash)
the_measurement.live_generate: a REAL generate() through the full admission + cascade: OK on xkiro qwen/qwen3.8-max:free, content ENGINE_LIVE_OK, cost_provenance FREE_TIER_API / OWNER_XKIRO_ACCOUNT / ZERO_PAID_COST
the_measurement.tests: tests/test_r456_free_tier_routers.py (25: registration + measured-evidence notes; the policy amendment + provenance; distinct account domains; the browser-UA transport on call + catalog; the 6 measured failure specimens + the 401/403 discipline; the capability unblock + the hermetic degraded tripwire) + the re-pinned zero_paid battery (37) — 97/97 with r415, 294+ green across the wide battery

honest_disclosures: free tiers are NOT permanent: pools congest (unorouter busy 403 measured; apinex glm/deepseek timeouts measured) — the cascade advances and the cooldown ladder retries; a fully-exhausted quartet degrades honestly to the localqwen baseline (typed, never silent)

the free routers expose NO per-model revision pin (no GGUF-sha equivalent) — recorded honest in each spec's model_revision (Art. VI); provenance rides the run-owned ledger lines (provider/model/attempt/status per call)

b.ai's premium catalog (claude/gpt/gemini flagships) stays deposit-gated: 403 'Deposit required' -> CREDIT_EXHAUSTED -> cascade advances; the operator has NOT authorized any deposit (ZERO_PAID_COST holds)

model quality on the engine's STRUCTURED protocol is unmeasured until a fresh production run completes — the registration proves TRANSPORT capability (probe-before-admit); the discovery-quality measurement is the next acceptance step (this round's fresh run)
